name: EKARA
shortDescription: Intelligent support for safer, more independent living.
fullDescription: EKARA is an AI voice-first assistance platform designed for older adults living independently. It provides daily schedule and routine information, simulated smart home front door telemetry, and safe caregiver alert logging.
examplePhrases: What do I need to do today?
Is anyone at my front door?
Tell my daughter I need help.
